title: Attractors and Singular Limits for a Quintic Wave Equation with Nonlocal Kelvin--Voigt Damping
summary: In this article, we consider an energy-critical quintic wave equation on a bounded domain $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^3$ with nonlinear and nonlocal Kelvin--Voigt damping of the form $-\|\nabla u_t\|_{L^2(Ω)}^αΔu_t$, where $α\in\mathbb{R}_+=[0,\infty)$. Under suitable hypotheses on the quintic source term, we establish the well-posedness of the problem and investigate its long-time dynamics in the natural energy space $\mathcal H=H_0^1(Ω)\times L^2(Ω)$.
